title: List
summary: A plain ordered or unordered prose list: bullets, numbers or checkmarks on items the host writes as plain elements, never a raw ul, ol or li.

props.name: ordered
props.description: Numbered instead of bulleted, when marker is auto (the default).

props.name: marker
props.description: The bullet: auto follows ordered (decimal when set, disc otherwise), disc and decimal force a style regardless of ordered, check draws a checkmark, none removes the marker and its indent (the list role stays; it comes from ARIA, not the native marker).

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items, on the spacing scale (none 0, xs --space-1, sm --space-2, md --space-4, lg --space-6, xl --space-8). Default xs.

slots.description: Items: plain elements (span, div, a) or pk-text inline. Never li; the list role and item count come from ARIA.

writes.why: An item without a role gets role=listitem so the list has the items the host role=list expects; a role the host set is left alone. Not removed. Kept when the element disconnects.

a11y: The host is role=list (named by label when set) and each item gets role=listitem unless it already has one. The marker is drawn by the browser's native ::marker on a display: list-item box, so it never carries the meaning alone; with marker=none the list-style is removed but the ARIA role stays, so the list and its item count still reach assistive technology.
